pr_title: wifi: driver: esp32: fix reconnection issue
pr_body:
Device won't reconnect automatically even if
AP station is available. This fix adds the carrier event, indicating
that network is present again enabling DHCP bound event.
Also, internal wifi event callback  was added into wifi driver to enable proper
event handling.

Fixes #33843

@tiborrr, `CONFIG_NET_ARP=y` is enabled by default with `CONFIG_NET_IPV4=y`.
The `<err> net_arp: Gateway not set for iface 0x3ffb0110` is a momentary gap between interface up event and DHCP IP assign. Once IP gets assigned, the error log ends. We will check this.

However, the log error isn't the root cause for connection issues.
You get the message `<inf> esp_event: WIFI_EVENT_STA_CONNECTED` but there is no callback regarding IP assignment?
I was getting the same error but it was because of my network's dhcp configuration, so I recommend testing on another network.

> I was getting the same error but it was because of my network's dhcp configuration, so I recommend testing on another network.

OK but this might also happen when you deploy to a customer. What settings should you adjust at the router side to fix this. Furthermore, why do other devices like my computer connect and the esp32 not?

Did you figure that out @marinbudimir ?
@tiborrr I guess I was able to reproduce this after a while. I'll PR soon.
